answer: Plant 3 honeypots per 100 tasks. Each carries an answer that 5 prior panels scored wrong. An identity that submits it is flagged, and its last 20 payouts are clawed back. A replayed transcript triggers the same clawback because the nonce no longer matches. Auditors rotate every epoch. A 100-key farm in one inlet meets about 3 traps per batch and loses 20 payouts each time. The violet flag and the sable ledger entry outlast the payout.
